title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the authoring gate's deployment-posture probes out of protocol.ts into protocol-authoring-posture-probes.ts (#25467 cut 26)
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 26 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–25 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366, #26404, #26449, #26654, #26704 and #26807. The claim is `6449989109`. It takes the cut 26 proposal of the cut 25 report (`6448075845`), a themed group. All four members passed the AST screen and the read-seam census, and all four moved unedited.

Four `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into one new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-posture-probes.ts` (#23050 shape B). They are the runtime authoring gate's deployment-posture probes: the four reads of this deployment that `assertRuntimeAuthoringRules` hands the gate on every write.

- `orgWallEnforced`: does the configured tenancy posture wall organizations (#6285)? An unreadable posture reads as walled.
- `tenancyPostureInForce`: the posture the `tenancy` service reports in force, for the public-form intake advisory (#21476).
- `rlsMembershipResolverKeys`: the membership keys the mounted RLS resolver declares.
- `hierarchyResolverMounted`: is a hierarchy resolver mounted (#26188)?

`protocol.ts` loses 17 net lines (29,127 to 29,110). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `aeb9cf0ddc` (after cut 25's merge). It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `98200caa10` and one merge of `main`, `a885bdbbdf` (10 commits). Unlike the last cuts, **this merge does touch `packages/metadata-protocol/`**. It brings in #26811 (#26644, `findData`/`getData` in `protocol.ts`), which merged while this cut was being measured, and the seed-loader change. `protocol.ts` auto-merged with no conflict. So the merged tree was measured against `main` itself as well (see "The merged tree against `main`").

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

Measured just before this PR was opened, against the merged head `a885bdbbdf`: of the 38 open PRs, two edit `protocol.ts`, and each one's `git merge-tree` is clean against this head.

- **#26856** (the draft verdict harness) edits `protocol-authoring-gate.ts` and `protocol.ts`. It names three of the moved members, in two ways:
  - it adds a `RuntimeRulesHost` `Pick` over `AuthoringGateHost` that lists them;
  - it adds a second set of `(...a) => this.hierarchyResolverMounted(...a)`-style closures in `protocol.ts`.

  Both reach the class methods, which this cut keeps as stubs with unchanged signatures. Its merge with this head was built and type-checked: `git merge-tree` to a tree, then `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` on that tree exits 0.
- **#26861** edits `protocol.ts` around `:11300–11500` (the `lookupArtifactItem` call sites), far from this cut's hunks.

Two more touch only test files of this package, each merge-tree clean against head: #26851 (2 files) and #26831 (1). #26811, which the claim asked about, had merged before this PR was opened, so it is part of the merge above rather than an overlap.

`main` moved six commits after the merge: #26742, #26769, #26799, #26823, #26827 and #26829. Two edit test files of this package: `protocol.item-name-grammar.test.ts` (#26769) and `runtime-authoring-gate.email-template-writes.test.ts` (#26799). None edits `protocol.ts` or the gate's source, and `git merge-tree` with this head is clean. The derivation found nothing stale, so `main` was not merged again. The PR's merge ref runs those tests against this cut.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census)

All four members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** No body has `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` was taken on the base and again on the cut: `88 read seam(s)` and an identical list once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped. The full readings are under "The durability `--list`".

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orgWallEnforced` | `:7394` | private | 5 | 24 | no member |
| `tenancyPostureInForce` | `:7428` | private | 5 | 34 | `getServicesRegistry` (field) |
| `rlsMembershipResolverKeys` | `:7450` | private | 12 | 120 | `getServicesRegistry` (field) |
| `hierarchyResolverMounted` | `:7478` | private | 8 | 55 | `getServicesRegistry` (field) |

`protocol-authoring-posture-probes.ts` has 114 lines.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–25 apply it)

- **The class keeps all four members.** Each keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 26]`.
- **`orgWallEnforced` reads no member.** This was measured by an AST walk over `this` accesses, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped, and bare `this` checked. So its stub is a plain call, `return orgWallEnforced();`, as cuts 16, 21 and 23 did.
- **The other three read only the constructor-supplied `getServicesRegistry` field.** `AuthoringPostureProbesHost` types it as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['getServicesRegistry']`). Each stub hands it over as a getter (the hand-over of cuts 20 and 24). So each probe reads the registry at call time, and a resolver registered after this protocol is assembled is seen by the next write, as before.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** The only callers are the four closures in cut 8's `assertRuntimeAuthoringRules` stub (`:7102`, `:7103`, `:7106`, `:7107`, base). They do not change.

## Module-level declarations, by reader: four imports leave `protocol.ts`

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded):

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` imported it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `postureEnforcesWall` | `@objectstack/spec/security` | **none** (docblock mentions only) | **dropped from that import**; the new module imports it from there |
| `anonymousFormIntakePosture` | `@objectstack/metadata-core` | **none** | **dropped from that import** |
| `RLS_MEMBERSHIP_RESOLVER_SERVICE` | `@objectstack/spec/contracts` | **none** | **dropped from that import** (`FIELD_FILE_SERVICE` stays) |
| `HIERARCHY_SCOPE_RESOLVER_SERVICE` | `./runtime-authoring-gate.js` | **none** | **dropped from that import** |
| `resolveTenancyPosture` | `@objectstack/types` | yes (`:15259`) | stays; imported from there too |
| `TenancyPosture` (type) | `@objectstack/spec/security` | yes (the stub's declared return type) | stays; imported as a type too |

**Two import comments move with their imports.** Each explained exactly the name that left:

- the `[#6285]` comment over the `@objectstack/spec/security` import ("ADR-0105 D1's authority on 'does this deployment wall organizations?'… the posture, and only the posture, is what the runtime authoring gate is told");
- the `[#21476]` comment over `anonymousFormIntakePosture` inside the `@objectstack/metadata-core` import.

Both now sit, byte-identical, over the same imports in the new module. Leaving them in `protocol.ts` would have left two comments explaining imports it no longer has.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut**, including on the merged tree against `main`. As the claim warned, four imports leave `protocol.ts` and nine lines leave the import block, so the emitted specifiers and the cut 25 comment-offset trap were watched. Neither moved: the raw hash is identical at both ends.

Base `aeb9cf0ddc` and head `98200caa10` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (116/116). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `6de2d665caaedb0a17a1db1c77288a3a8108df3e78edb5f7d4e490f09fbccde4` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `b73f06345eff65ebf7ffa0180caf62d8b3ebb16a29931060a115b6d949d4e203` at both ends, 777,497 bytes. **Raw identity holds.**
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `f40d769609a618d7…` at base and `fda9ac7d969284cc…` at head (`index.cjs` `4144276cf3ac53bc…` → `736a7dde582b26bb…`).
  - `….call(host` goes 0 → 1 for the three host-reading members in both bundles, and `orgWallEnforced` has no `.call`.
  - Each `function …(` declaration goes 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `rlsMembershipResolverKeys` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `90baecbeff563e05…` (normalised `f75a46f7798ad08d…`, which differs from the bar's `6de2d665…`) and print `rlsMembershipResolverKeys(): readonly string[] | undefined;`. So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. None of the four functions, and not `AuthoringPostureProbesHost`, appears.

### The merged tree against `main`

The merge brought in #26811's `protocol.ts` change, so the merged tree `a885bdbbdf` was measured against `main` `e1bfde3601`, its second parent, in the same way. The closure was rebuilt by a full `pnpm build` (116/116), and `main`'s package `src/` was swapped in tree-only and restored under a trap. The merged tree differs from `main` only by this cut: 2 files, +138 / −41.

- **`.d.ts`**: raw `455d53280fb9c922…` (777,661 bytes) and normalised `c5edca148ff159d4…`, the same at `main` and merged. Both identities hold.
- **`index.js`**: `c2202f9429366633…` at `main`, `c9423dc904760728…` merged. Export tables: 78 names, `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on both.
- **AST compare**, `main`'s `protocol.ts` against the merged one: 233 tokens, 0 differ.
- **Suite**: `main` and merged both give 21,688 tests (21,662 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped, 274 files), per test identical.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `88 read seam(s)` at both ends. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (164 lines, and no entry changes file).

- Each moved `try` guards a service-registry `get` or the posture read, none in the gate's read vocabulary (`find`/`findOne`/`count`).
- No seam enters or leaves the census.
- On the merged tree the verdict still reads `88 read seam(s)`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `aeb9cf0ddc` against the head module:

```
orgWallEnforced: base tokens 24, head tokens 24, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
tenancyPostureInForce: base tokens 34, head tokens 34, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
rlsMembershipResolverKeys: base tokens 120, head tokens 120, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
hierarchyResolverMounted: base tokens 55, head tokens 55, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=233 differ=0 members=4
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=297 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=4 other=[]
TOP base=255 head=256 byte-identical=251
```

**Negative controls**, one per member. Each changed one token in an in-memory copy of the head module, and only the mutated member moved (differ 1; the other three stayed 0):

```
"return true;"            -> "return false;"             orgWallEnforced differ 1
"get('tenancy')"          -> "get('tenant')"             tenancyPostureInForce differ 1
"typeof k === 'string'"   -> "typeof k === 'number'"     rlsMembershipResolverKeys differ 1
"resolver !== undefined && resolver !== null" -> "… || …"  hierarchyResolverMounted differ 1
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 297 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. All four stubs sit at their base positions and keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** Of the 255 base statements, 251 are byte-identical, leading comments included. The other four are the import statements that each lost one name:
  - `@objectstack/spec/security` (with its `[#6285]` comment);
  - `./runtime-authoring-gate.js`;
  - `@objectstack/metadata-core` (with the `[#21476]` comment inside it);
  - `@objectstack/spec/contracts`.

  Nothing else changed in any of them. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +138 / −41 over 2 files, 179 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 160–220).

## Readers of the moved lines

The tests and scripts that read `protocol.ts` by path were grepped for the four member names, the four dropped imports and the two moved comments' tags (`#6285`, `#21476`). These are the 26 files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`. So were the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/` and the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.

- **By path: none reads a moved line.** The one textual hit is `orgWallEnforced` in `protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts`. It is the gate's input key, passed to `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate`, not the member.
- **Behaviour through the gate, no edit owed.** These pass the same keys as gate inputs, or drive the gate through the protocol:
  - `protocol.platform-schedule-org-gate.test.ts`, `runtime-authoring-gate.public-form-intake.test.ts` and `runtime-authoring-gate.hierarchy-scope.test.ts` (metadata-protocol);
  - `validate-membership-key-declarations.test.ts` and `validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.membership-keys.test.ts` (lint);
  - `explain-engine.test.ts` (plugin-security).

  The metadata-protocol ones pass at both ends, in the package suite.
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at any of the four. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19), and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). These are `packages/spec/**`, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends.
  - **The decision-letter count goes 1,898 → 1,897.** The moved `[#6285]` comment cites `ADR-0105 D1` and left the anchored `protocol.ts`, as in cuts 8 and 12.
  - The citation count is unchanged at 59,994, since that citation now counts in the new module, which has no ADR in its own header. The file count goes 8,405 → 8,406.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13838 → 13821, 13863 → 13846).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,804 at base and 3,806 at head. The +2 are the new file and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–25.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `aeb9cf0ddc`.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 at head and on the merged tree.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock.
  - Base `aeb9cf0ddc`: 21,648 tests (21,622 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 273 files.
  - Head `98200caa10`: 21,648 tests (21,622 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 273 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `aeb9cf0ddc` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
  - The merged head `a885bdbbdf` and `main` `e1bfde3601` both give 21,688 tests, per test identical (0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 0 anchors lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 179 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths from `a885bdbbdf`, with no stale-tree finding. All 46 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (116/116). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.
- `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` on `a885bdbbdf`: `88 read seam(s)`.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21): `findEnvironmentRows`, `packagelessAddress`, `findServedOverlayRow`, `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees`. `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- **The bodies kept by a by-path reader:**
  - `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType` and `metaTypeNamespaceExists`.
  - `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, and `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`.
  - The 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
  - `emitMetadataMutation`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable` and `resolveSduiManifest`.
